periods.glance: Kingdom of Italy, 1861 to 1885. About 18.6 million to 22.2 million people in 1861 (estimates differ). Official religion: Catholicism. Leaders: Bettino Ricasoli, Camillo Benso di Cavour, Luigi Carlo Farini and others. Movements: Risorgimento.
